info.syllabusName: Đào tạo và phát triển nguồn nhân lực (Training and Development)
info.description:
Chapter 1: Overview and Introduction

Chapter 2: Organizing and Managing Learning and Talent Development

Chapter 3: Organization contexts

Chapter 4: Learning theories

Chapter 5: Establishing Needs and solutions to talent development

Chapter 6: Learning and Talent development practical strategies

Chapter 7: Designing and Evaluating Training and Development

Chapter 8: Assessing and Managing Resources

Chapter 9: Ethics and professionalism in learning and talent development
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Describe the overview of training and development perspectives and learning theories
Identify training needs and conduct need analysis of employees and organizations
Design training courses based on needs analysis, understanding objectives, methods of training In order to support business strategies
Demonstrate effective teamwork in delivering training sessions and evaluate training programs
Implement Ethics and professionalism in learning and talent development activities.
